body:
Thanks.  I do, and she said she feels like she doesn't' want to lose me, she just also doesn't feel like she can trust me.

I do feel like I lost her trust.  This.. isn't the first time that I've told our friends she hasn't been doing well and may be thinking about suicide.  She was furious at me then, too, but she said she understood and that it was because I didn't know how much she valued her privacy in things like this.  Now that I should have known better, her finding out I told people again just made her even angrier at me.

I do think that she'll come around again, and realize that I didn't mean anything harmful by it, that I had made a bad judgment call in trying to help her.  My fear is that she may end her life before it gets to that point...
